name: sentinelone-mcp
description: Every SentinelOne v2.1 management endpoint, plus an offline SQLite store and cross-entity analytics — fleet health, threat triage, blast radius, drift — that no console view offers.

sentinelone_api_token.title: SENTINELONE_API_TOKEN
sentinelone_api_token.description: Sets SENTINELONE_API_TOKEN for the SentinelOne MCP server.

sentinelone_base_url.title: SentinelOne console API base URL
sentinelone_base_url.description: Base URL of your SentinelOne management console API, including the version path, e.g. https://usea1-partners.sentinelone.net/web/api/v2.1. The shipped default points at an example host.
